source: Reconciled live Shopify evidence, local contracts, Product Release Record, Media Registry, PipelineRun, and strict 2026-08-14 end-to-end gap audit; secrets, customer data, and raw provider references are excluded
evidenceBoundary: Technical access evidence is historical observation only. It never grants release, publication, cart, checkout, payment, order, fulfillment, refund, or Production authority.

canonicalOwners.fulfillmentTruth: Verified POD and carrier events reconciled to Shopify
